bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W192: Governed Runner Result Capture Writer Contract And File Output. Use W191 server adapter polling support to define and implement the governed runner result-capture writer that, after the internal runner creates or resolves Customer, demo transaction, hero item, matrix/proof item, and component item records, writes a completed result JSON file into the configured result-capture folder named with runnerTaskId/idempotency token.
